title: decree prune --format json
description: What `decree prune --format json` prints on stdout: the finished runs it deleted, or with --dry-run would delete, and their size. A run that could not be pruned is reported on stderr, and the exit code is then 1, after this document. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

runs.description: The runs deleted (or that would be), in id order.

bytes.description: The size of their files, in bytes; text prints it in KB, MB or GB.

run.description: One pruned run, from its `run_finished` event.

state.description: The final state the run ended in.

finished.description: The `ts` of its `run_finished` event: RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.
